GigGok — let Mind use the phone for you
Lets Mind read the screen, tap and type for you, only while doing a task you asked for

Mind reads the screen as text and taps, types, scrolls or opens apps for you, only while doing a task you asked for · when it has permission, GigGok turns this service on for the task and off again afterwards · it never opens or touches banking, finance or wallet apps, password fields, or app-install and permission screens · it asks you before sending, paying, buying or deleting · stop it any time from the notification
